definitions: Strengthening or supporting (an object or substance), especially with additional material.
Making (a feeling, idea, or habit) stronger or more pronounced.
Providing (a place) with extra troops or support to strengthen its defence.
Increasing the number or amount of (a force or effect).
examples: reinforcing the concrete with steel bars
reinforcing the idea that hard work pays off
reinforcing the front line with fresh troops
reinforcing the positive effects of exercise
